summary: Show host-reported DHCP address and gateway in the management network form.

guide.reason: The disabled DHCP fields now show the host's observed address and gateway when available.

api.reason: Core inventory management_network adds optional observed_gateway from br0's default IPv4 route; GET /api/v1/hosts/{id}/network passes it through with existing NIC addresses. POST and management-network commands are unchanged. Older Core omits the field; upgrade Controller first for strict report decoding.

roadmap.reason: The display improvement changes no milestone scope or acceptance status.

state.reason: Only live Core observations are added. Existing host network files and the Core management-network record remain the durable configuration, recovered in inventory by a fresh Controller.

verification.method: Focused Go, UI and contract checks passed; a simulated browser fixture exercised fresh DHCP, Static switching, report error and stale host states. The fixture did not obtain a real DHCP lease.
